They are now hidden and stay under the bench until the find. Read the test's intent (custody preserved across scenes by non-matching filler) and update the expectation to the new truth for the clue items (still under the park bench, hidden) while keeping the assertions for the items whose custody is unchanged.

Final report: per file what changed and why, any budget or window issue found, and anything you refused to paper over.
